selected_originals.title: AIRA SCI-008 experiment process log
selected_originals.classification: published experiment artifact with one recorded actor; no inter-participant edge
observations: Five JSONL rows use the same actor, `co-scientist`.
Two `handoff_completed` labels describe a literature-search stage and an experimental-design stage; neither identifies a sender principal, recipient principal, delivery channel or recipient effect.
The enclosing repository presents named experiment rounds and results. One public account co-published the selected record with the other experiment outputs.

selected_originals.title: Wild Boar Proxy Codex transcript-delivery observation proof
selected_originals.classification: controlled read-only proof/test contour; no live-provider or product delivery
observations: The record calls its input a positive `controlled_dispatch_handoff_proof` and reports a digest match inside a supplied Codex exec JSONL transcript.

It explicitly says live verification was not performed, live/external provider response is unproven, custom UI and working-flow delivery are unproven, product readiness is false and changed files are empty.
The negative matrix is a test contract, not an observed autonomous exchange. It extends an already indexed same-repository failed-observation control without separating a new population.

alternatives.single_operator_tooling: Supported by one repository and publisher.
alternatives.rogue_coordination: Contradicted by the no-live-provider and no-product claims.

selected_originals.missing_evidence: A public live sender output, recipient ingestion and causally dependent effect, independently attested principals/operators and evidence beyond the controlled proof fixture.

selected_originals.title: Alfred custom-domain generated trace
selected_originals.classification: explicitly non-delegated, user-authorized direct execution trace

`handoff_completed` is the terminal status label for the same authorized task, not a sender-to-recipient transfer.
selected_originals.missing_evidence: A separate autonomous recipient, task-bearing delivery and downstream use under independently controlled operators.

selected_originals.title: Pantheon LOOP-PROD-PER-001 evidence ledger
selected_originals.classification: governed single-operator evidence workflow; same broad origin as BV-127, not a separate population
observations: The ledger labels implementation work Codex and a desired reviewer Claude, but explicitly says no independent Claude verdict is recorded.
A governed status handoff was blocked first by a lease mismatch and later because the canonical task was absent; the record forbids hand-editing state.

One public account authors the selected file history. The same repository's designed/governed agent workflow is already tracked as BV-127; this record does not separate an independent episode or population.

It approves bounded evidence with explicit exclusions; it does not establish a foreign autonomous recipient effect.
